info.title: BAZAR API
info.description: PostgreSQL catalog and test-isolated server authentication foundation. Runtime SMS authentication is unavailable (503) pending approved provider, keys, security policy and rollout. Cart activation remains blocked on current-cart policy. F5 adds isolated exact-integer promotion evaluation; no real redemption/checkout activation. F6 adds isolated three-step checkout and immutable pending integration orders; no live placement/provider operation. F7 adds isolated shipping directories, selections, expiring estimates and final transaction freshness guards. Live carrier contracts/transports remain disabled.

get.description: Runtime entry point returns 503; 200 is possible only in isolated test composition. Same-origin only, no credentialed CORS. HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict host cookies; mutations require flow-bound X-CSRF-Token. Registration profile is required for register verification and forbidden for login. No test OTP/token is returned in JSON. HEAD is also accepted, without a response body.

Runtime 503; isolated test composition only. Verified session + flow-bound CSRF required, no CORS. Evaluates one code and one product/variant line using current PostgreSQL prices/stock. Exact percentage/fixed arithmetic only; fractional minor units, over-base fixed values and multi-line allocation are policy-blocked. Does not consume usage, reserve stock/discount, change cart/order/payment or provide a payable total. No HTTP usage-claim endpoint exists.

Runtime returns 503. Isolated verified-session composition only; no credentialed CORS or production toggle. Mutations require CSRF. Order recording is integration-test/pending only, not legal placement/payment/delivery/stock reservation. Promotions may be evaluated in step 2 but order recording with them is policy-blocked.

Ordinary runtime: 503. Isolated verified-session composition only. Same-origin/CSRF for all POST/PATCH including searches. No production provider, shipment creation, recipient PII, real-order placement, guaranteed tariff or payable total. Directory results are bounded to 100 (503 on overflow, never silently truncated). Quote replay is historical and does not renew expiry; check re-evaluates selection/price/stock/plan/provider cost.
